Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Items of November 1, 2017
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
Palos Verdes Drive West Mid-Block Pedestrian Crossing
Recommended
Action: Recommend to the City Council that they authorize preparation of a traffic study, appropriate funding for the study, and direct staff to solicit proposals for professional services to collect appropriate data, solicit information and participation from area residents, Palos Verdes Unified School District and Lunada Bay Little League, and develop feasible alternatives with cost estimates to address the issue of pedestrian activity and connectivity to all facilities in the area; and also have the Police Department place a decoy or other methods to slow traffic. (4-0 in favor, Margolf absent).
Staff Report
9.
Parklands Committee Meeting Items of November 9, 2017
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
PC-476-17; Application to remove or top and trim 4 pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to 1113 Via Mirabel
Applicant: Reed and Nan Harman
1820 Via Visalia
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve the application with modification to the City Council to remove the Canary Island pine with bark beetles and the Torrey pine tree. The remaining 2 trees are approved for trimming. Payment of $1,000 and removal of the stumps are required. (5-0 in favor).
b.
PC-478-17; Application to modify the existing grade in Parklands adjacent to 1405 Via Montemar
Applicant: Edmund Yee
1405 Via Montemar
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended
Action: Recommend to the City Council that the applicant perform grading within the Parklands within substantial conformance with the authorized grading plan to modify the grade adjacent to 1405 Via Montemar. Require the altered grade to be restored to the authorized grading plan, remove and replace the Aleppo pine with the largest available box tree, submit a native restoration plan for the disturbed Parklands and pay a restoration fee for the damaged Aleppo pine to be determined by the Planning director. Staff to determine if the stump is required to be removed and upon identification of slope stability conditions, staff will require additional geotechnical review. (5-0 in favor).
c.
PC-479-17; Application to remove 5 Liquidambar trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2517 Via Rivera
Applicant: Bob and Marilyn White
2517 Via Rivera
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve the application to remove 5 Liquidambar trees located in the parkways adjacent to 2517 Via Rivera according to the 'Standard Conditions For Tree Removal Approvals'. (3-0-2 in favor, Rubincam and Richie-Bray recused). Require a $2,500 payment to the 'Tree Bank' and removal of the stumps.
d.

Applicant: Matt Soufl
75 Malaga Cove #14
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve the application to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the parkway adjacent to 549 Palos Verdes Drive West according to the 'Standard Conditions For Tree Removal Approvals'. Require $500 payment to the 'Tree Bank' and removal of the stump. (5-0 in favor).
e.

Applicant: Eileen Drake
1425 Via Galica
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve the application to retain 5 ficus trees planted in the Parklands adjacent to 1425 Via Galicia. Require removal of the irrigation pipes and sprinklers in the Parklands and provide minor grading to repair the hole. (5-0 in favor).
f.

Applicant: Junru Pan
25332 Narbonne Ave. Suite 100
Lomita, CA 90717
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve the application to remove 1 Olive tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1816 Paseo Del Mar according to the 'Standard Conditions For Tree Removal Approval'. (5-0 in favor). Require a payment of $500 to the 'Tree Bank' and removal of the stump.
g.
Boy Scout Project to provide improvements to the Peafowl Enclosure Adjacent to City Hall
Applicant: Joey Graziano
4209 Via Valmonte
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Applicant: City of Rancho Palos Verdes
Recommended
Action: Recommend to approve to authorize the City of Rancho Palos Verdes to construct and fund a decomposed granite pathway connecting to the existing pathway located in the Palos Verdes Drive West median.

Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of CDP-107-17; Coastal Development Permit Application for a New Wrought Iron Fence, Gate, and Landscaping at the Single Family Residence Located at 2801 Via Segovia. Lot 1, Tract 23062. This Project is Exempt from CEQA Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application, and adopt Resolution R17-41; approving on appeal from the Planning Commission CDP 107-17; Coastal Development Permit application for a new wrought iron fence, gate, and landscaping at the single family residence located at 2801 Via Segovia. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Staff Report
11.
Continuation of Public Hearing: Introduction of Ordinance 17-725; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates Amending Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in order to Expressly Ban Commercial (Medical and Non-Medical) Marijuana Activities, Allow for the Delivery of Medical Marijuana, Reasonably Regulate Indoor Cultivation of Marijuana for Personal Use, and Ban all Outdoor Cultivation of Marijuana; and Amending Section 8.56.020 (Smoking Prohibited) to Include Additional Locations where Smoking is Prohibited in Light of Current State Laws Regarding Recreational Marijuana Use
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council continue the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and introduce upon first reading Ordinance 17-725; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates Amending Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in order to Expressly Ban Commercial (Medical and Non-Medical) Marijuana Activities, Allow for the Delivery of Medical Marijuana, Reasonably Regulate Indoor Cultivation of Marijuana for Personal Use, and Ban all Outdoor Cultivation of Marijuana; and Amending Section 8.56.020 (Smoking Prohibited) to Include Additional Locations where Smoking is Prohibited in Light of Current State Laws Regarding Recreational Marijuana Use. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Staff Report
